observations.title: Startup Booster Poland – Smart UP – oferta dla startupów

claims.statement: The startup-facing Smart UP page lists a 17 June 2024 to 31 May 2026 application window and explicitly marks recruitment ended.
claims.temporal_scope: application window 2024-06-17 through 2026-05-31; closed as observed

claims.statement: The offer describes accelerator and post-accelerator support and an overall maximum grant of PLN 400,000 for eligible selected micro or small startups.
claims.temporal_scope: application window 2024-06-17 through 2026-05-31; closed as observed

claims.statement: The development routes listed include business/public-partner acceleration, VC readiness, sector-agnostic acceleration, Go Global, and Poland Prize soft landing for teams from abroad wishing to establish and grow a business in Poland.
claims.temporal_scope: application window 2024-06-17 through 2026-05-31; closed as observed

enumeration.limitations: Programme maximum is not a grant received by any company. Operator terms and path-specific limits require separate checks; Poland Prize is a PARP route, not a PAIH-operated funding round.

observations.retrieval_timestamp_note: Timestamp records completion of this bounded evidence-reading pass; reads occurred between 09:45 and 09:48 UTC on this date.

claims.statement: The startup-facing Startups Exchange offer lists applications from 23 September 2026 through 7 January 2028 and targets Polish startups with international potential.
The support ceiling is PLN 100,000 combining services and a grant; services may not exceed PLN 80,000 and a grant may be at most 25% of financed services.
The programme describes a domestic preparation phase and an overseas phase involving incubation, acceleration, mentoring, study visits or trade missions.
The displayed StartSmart CEE operator opens recruitment on 2026-12-07, after this research date; the umbrella programme date does not imply that this operator is already accepting applications.

enumeration.limitations: Displayed overall window does not prove any specific accelerator round is open on a given day. Support is services plus grant, not an equity investment or all-cash grant.
